exposure: Clinics where the absolute CS rate had fallen by more than two percent between 2008 and 2016
multiparous women with single cephalic at term pregnancy with history of CS
single, cephalic nulliparous women, at term in spontaneous labor
single, cephalic nulliparous women, at term in induced labor or CS before labor
cohort: Births in Flanders, Belgium, from 1992 to 2016
finding: The increase in cesarean section rates in Flanders between 1992 and 2016 is primarily attributed to an increase in nulliparous women with a single cephalic baby at term in spontaneous or induced labor and in women with a previous cesarean section.
